what: An unavailable enterprise-to-equity input was substituted with zero, and the sensitivity grid published a per-share value built on that zero while the method's own per-share leg refused. The grid now converts only through the governed conversion, withholds every per-share cell when that conversion refuses, and the DCF evidence claim states the refusal.
governingRule: Unavailable inputs must remain unavailable. They must never silently become zero and produce an apparently valid valuation or sensitivity result.

rootCause.why: The grid re-implemented the enterprise-to-equity bridge inline with nullish-coalescing defaults instead of calling the governed conversion used by the DCF method's per-share leg, so an absence the payload published as MISSING/NOT_REPORTED became the number 0 for the purposes of the division.

secondSite.defect: The EV-DCF_FCFF claim read 'DCF_FCFF produced a per-share value from N present input(s)' and declared supports = valuation.methods[0].output.perShareMid even when that output was NOT_COMPUTABLE with value null.

sensitivity.before: every cell carried a per-share number derived from enterprise value with net debt, minority interest, preference capital and associates assumed nil

evidence.before: DCF_FCFF produced a per-share value from 3 present input(s)

unaffected: confidence, quality, risk, moat, dividends, limitations — unchanged

correction.approach: narrowest: the grid's conversion now runs through the same governed functions the DCF per-share leg uses, and the evidence claim is derived from the per-share output it supports

gridBehaviour.conversionRefused: every point: value = null, enterpriseValue = <the discounted enterprise value that did compute>; grid.withheld = { presence: NOT_COMPUTABLE, reason, note }
gridBehaviour.conversionSucceeded: every point: { waccBps, growthBps, value } and no withheld block — byte-identical to the pre-correction shape, so every committed payload digest still reproduces

evidenceBehaviour.refused: DCF_FCFF produced no per-share value: NOT_COMPUTABLE (NOT_REPORTED) — enterprise-to-equity conversion blocked by netDebt
evidenceBehaviour.succeeded: DCF_FCFF produced a per-share value from N present input(s) (unchanged)

notDone: no replacement per-share number was manufactured
no D-2 semantics, valuation policy, authorized parameter or unrelated valuation formula was changed
the enterprise-value column is retained only as diagnostic arithmetic and is labelled '(diagnostic)' in the rendered view; it is never published as a per-share value
no dataset row, ingest input, source extract or historical payload was rewritten

supersededEvidence.meaning: the original WI-8 run of record, kept byte-identical as historical evidence of the defect; its sensitivity per-share cells and its EV-DCF_FCFF claim are invalid and must not be used as a valuation

correctedEvidence.producedBy: the same ingest input, the same generatedAt and the same datasetVersion as the original run; reproduced twice with the same digest

changedPathsSummary: 1 evidence claim; 9 sensitivity points (value -> null, enterpriseValue added); 1 grid withheld block

covers: missing current investments blocks net debt and withholds the grid
missing net debt alone withholds every cell
missing debt component blocks gross debt and withholds
missing minority interest / preference capital withholds and names the component
the refused grid agrees with the method's own refused per-share leg
no published cell equals the zero-substituted number
the enterprise-value column is quarantined and is not a per-share value
a healthy grid carries no withheld block and no EV column
the evidence claim states the refusal, with reason and blocking component
a converted method keeps the original claim unchanged
a declared nil converts as a declared nil
the same item missing — not declared nil — withholds
valid grids keep nine monotone cells and the base point at the DCF mid
a refused grid keeps the enterprise-value arithmetic that did compute
